load_motions_bvh: load BVH motion files into MotionWithVelocity objects using a skeleton and character info
load_motions_pickle: load pickled motion data from bin or gzip files into motion objects
collect_motion_files_cluster: collect motion files from a project directory using cluster labels and a label file
collect_motion_files_sample: collect and sample motion files from directories with random or top selection methods
review_load_motions: review the load_motions function to understand how it handles BVH, bin, and gzip motion file formats
